situation: Friends deciding where to go on Saturday.
topic: What time does the Tate Modern close on a Friday, and is entry free?

text: Saturday tate modern? Anyone know what time it closes on fridays and if entry is free 🤔 @claude

Tate Modern's page says it's open 10:00 to 21:00 on Fridays and Saturdays. Last entry is 20:30. Entry to the collection is free. Exhibitions usually cost extra, and the page recommends booking them. The page didn't give exhibition prices.

https://www.tate.org.uk/visit/tate-modern
